dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Vou contar-te um segredo. <$comeff(2,3)>Isto é, na verdade,
Uma pedra. <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,3)>Não é um ovo em tudo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,5)>No waaay!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,18)>I had no idea. So does that mean rocks are, uh<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>...actually
kinda tasty?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,5)>Não waaay!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,18)>Isso significa que as pedras são...<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>...na verdade
Um bocado saboroso?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,2)>Oh, come ooon!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,2)>Oh, vamos lá!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, check this out!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Olha para isto!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s up, yo? <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Wh-whoa!!!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>O que se passa, meu? <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Wh-whoa!!!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, it’s just some trash. It was super shiny, <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>so I thought it
was treasure, but...guess not.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim, é só um lixo. <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Então eu pensei
era um tesouro, mas... não.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Are you kiddin’ me?! This is totally treasure! What an
amazing find!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Você está brincando comigo?! Isso é totalmente tesouro!
Uma descoberta incrível!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Really?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>A sério?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Just the right amount of filth... Not too dirty, not too clean.
And it smells awesome! It’s got my mouth waterin’, yo!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I wanna dig in and scarf it all down right now!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Apenas a quantidade certa de imundície... não muito suja, não muito limpa.
E cheira incrível! Ele tem a minha boca molhar’, yo!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Eu quero cavar e encharcar tudo agora mesmo!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Now you mention it, I guess it DOES look kinda special...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Agora que falas nisso, acho que parece especial...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>So, uh... You don’t need this for anything, right, <$cdef(27)>Meowth?
Can I have it? Pleeeaaase?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>Então... não precisas disto para nada, certo? <$cdef(27)>Meowth?
Posso ficar com ele?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? N-No way! <$comeff(1,11)>It’s mine! I’m the one who found it!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>This treasure belongs to ME!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Nem pensar! <$comeff(1,11)>É meu! Fui eu que encontrei!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Este tesouro pertence-ME!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>Awww... No way... I’m so jealous, yo!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>Awww... De jeito nenhum... Estou tão ciumento, yo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>You know, every time I see you, your fur is so glossy and
beautiful.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,23)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>I get nervous just being close to you...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>sabe, sempre que te vejo, a tua pele é tão brilhante e
Lindo.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,23)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Fico nervoso por estar perto de ti...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)>Oh? Why might that be?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)>Porquê?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Well, as you can see, my whole body is made up of
garbage.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,18)>I’d never forgive myself if I dirtied your beautiful fur...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Bem, como podem ver, todo o meu corpo é feito de
Lixo.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,18)>Eu nunca me perdoaria se eu sujasse sua bela pele...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>No need to worry about that, dear. I’ll be fine.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Não precisa se preocupar com isso, querida. Vou ficar bem.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, how very kind of you. You don’t mind getting dirty?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, como é muito gentil da sua parte. Você não se importa de ficar sujo?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>I wouldn’t say that! I just don’t think it’s likely.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>In fact, I have every confidence my fur will stay clean.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,13)>Go ahead—touch it to your heart’s content.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Eu não diria isso! Eu só não acho que é provável.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Na verdade, tenho toda a confiança que a minha pele ficará limpa.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,13)>Vá em frente — toque no conteúdo do seu coração.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$motionoff(1,807)>Well, if you’re sure...here I go!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>How’s this?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$motionoff(1,807)>Bem, se você tem certeza... aqui vou eu!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>Que tal isso?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motionoff(2,816)>Well? What do you think?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motionoff(2,816)>Então, o que achas?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,15)>My goodness! You don’t have so much as a speck of dust
on you! That really is impressive.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,15)>Meu Deus! Você não tem tanto quanto um grão de poeira
Isso é realmente impressionante.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>Hopefully your concerns are put to rest!
My fur repels dust. ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>Esperemos que as suas preocupações sejam postas para descansar!
A minha pele repele o pó.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$textsize(0)>As long as it doesn’t repel every last bit of me...</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$textsize(0)>Contanto que não repela cada último pedaço de mim...</textsize>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>ZORUA! Hey, you haven’t seen my captain around,
have ya?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>ZORUAEi, você não viu o meu capitão por aí,
Não é verdade?

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? Your captain? Uh-uh, I haven’t seen them.
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>- O seu capitão?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Dang, really? Grrr... I can’t find them anywhere.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Droga, sério? Grrr... Eu não consigo encontrá-los em qualquer lugar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK! If I see them, I’ll tell you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK! Se eu vê-los, eu vou dizer-lhe!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, Captain! I was looking EVERYWHERE for you!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Capitão, estava à sua procura em todo o lado!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Well hi there, <$cdef(27)>Tatsugiri</color>! What’s up?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Bem, olá. <$cdef(27)>Tatsugiri</color>O que se passa?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Huh? Uhhh... You seem a little OFF today, Cap...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Pareces um pouco desligado hoje, Capitão...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(3,4)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,5)>N-no, I’m totally fine! I’m definitely your captain!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(3,4)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,5)>N-não, estou totalmente bem! Eu sou definitivamente o seu capitão!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>I knew it—something IS off about you! You AREN’T my
captain! Um, I’m right... Right?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu sabia – algo está errado em você! Você não é meu
Capitão, estou certo, certo?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Darn it! I thought I did a really good job, too! How could
you tell?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Pensei que também tinha feito um bom trabalho.
Tu contas-me?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Cap calls me something totally different! And the way you
were talking was totally off too!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Besides, if ANYONE is good at imitating the captain,
it’s me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>O Capitão chama-me de algo totalmente diferente.
Estava a falar fora de questão também!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Além disso, se alguém é bom em imitar o capitão,
Sou eu!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh yeah? Then go ahead and show me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Então vai em frente e mostra-me!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(2,634)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>!!!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! I’m playing dead! Well, whatcha think?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(2,634)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>!!!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! Eu estou me fazendo de morto! Bem, o que você acha?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>You’re just lying down!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Você está apenas deitado!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,635)><$voicel(2,9)>Hehehe—naw, this is way harder than it looks! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>You got at
least a million years to go before you’re ready to be
imitating my captain, kid!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,635)><$voicel(2,9)>Hehehe-naw, isso é muito mais difícil do que parece! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Chegaste a...
pelo menos um milhão de anos para ir antes de você está pronto para ser
A imitar o meu capitão, miúdo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Nnngh... I swear I’m gonna look EXACTLY like your
captain one day <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>and totally surprise you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Nnngh... Eu juro que vou olhar exatamente como o seu
Capitão, um dia <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>e surpreendê-lo totalmente!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Um e-excuse me... Do...do you have a minute? I was...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>I was wondering... Can you teach me how to camouflage
the way you do?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Desculpe, tem um minuto?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Estava a pensar... pode ensinar-me a camuflar?
Da maneira que tu fazes?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>? Sure, but...nobody’ll be able to see
your camouflage under that cloth.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>? Claro, mas ... ninguém vai ser capaz de ver
A tua camuflagem debaixo desse pano.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, um...I was gonna take the cloth off once I learned
how to camouflage myself properly...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Bem, hum... eu ia tirar o pano assim que aprendesse
Como me camuflar corretamente...

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh. Well, if that’s what you want, <$cdef(27)>Mimikyu, I can teach
you...but it’s not super easy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, se é isso que quer, <$cdef(27)>MimikyuEu posso ensinar.
você ... mas não é super fácil!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>R-right. Yeah, OK... I guess that figures...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Sim, está bem, acho que isso...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Why do you wanna learn how to camouflage yourself,
anyway?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Porque quer aprender a camuflar-te?
De qualquer forma?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, since I don’t have any friends...<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>I thought...maybe if I
looked less scary, then other Pokémon would wanna be
friends with me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, já que não tenho amigos...<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu pensei... talvez se eu...
parecia menos assustador, então outro Pokémon iria querer ser
Amigos comigo.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? What do you mean? You and me are friends!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Tu e eu somos amigos!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? Wait, what? Really? <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Wow, I’m friends with <$cdef(27)>Zorua...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>That’s so cool! Heh heh heh...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Espera, o quê? <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Uau, eu sou amigo de <$cdef(27)>Zorua...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Isso é tão legal! Heh heh heh...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Hee hee! You’re so silly, <$cdef(27)>Mimikyu</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Hee hee! Você é tão bobo, <$cdef(27)>Mimikyu</color>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>*fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Aww...no good, huh?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>* fwsh fwsh fwsh *
<$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Não é bom, pois não?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>No! Don’t give up! Next time, give it more PASSION!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Really DIG DEEP and get in there!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>Não! Não desista! Da próxima vez, dê-lhe mais PASSÃO!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>A sério, dig DEEP e entrar lá!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,12)>Um, OK!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>*fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>Aww. Yeah... See what I mean? Generating electricity is
pretty tough.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,12)>Está bem!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>* fwsh fwsh fwsh *
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>A geração de electricidade é o que se passa.
Muito difícil.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>You can DO THIS, Pawmi! Try it gently this time! Almost
like...like you’re warming up an egg!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Você pode fazer isso, Pawmi! Tente suavemente desta vez! Quase
como... como se você estivesse aquecendo um ovo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Um, would you mind showing me what you mean,
<$cdef(27)>Dedenne?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Importas-te de me mostrar o que quer dizer,
<$cdef(27)>Dedenne?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Hmmm? No chance, sorry! I can’t MAKE electricity at all!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Hmmm? Nenhuma chance, desculpe! Eu não posso fazer eletricidade em tudo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,5)>Wha—? Then why are you giving me that
know-it-all advice?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,5)>Então, porque me está a dar isso?
Sabe-tudo?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Because once you CAN make electricity, I want you to
share it with me sometimes!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>It’s totally fine! YOU! HAVE! THE! TALENT!
...Probably!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Porque uma vez que você pode fazer eletricidade, eu quero que você
Às vezes, partilha-o comigo!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Está tudo bem! VOCÊ! TEM! O! Talento!
...Provavelmente!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Oh. I’m just...shocked. I’ve been practicing so hard with
you, but still...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Estou apenas... chocado. Eu tenho praticado tão duro com
Tu, mas mesmo assim...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Shocked, huh? OK, great! Now take that shock and
SLAM it into your cheeks!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Ok, ótimo! Agora tome esse choque e
Enfia-o nas bochechas!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)>Haaaaaa—AAAAAA— *fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,859)>*crackle ZAP*
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>I...I DID IT!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)>Haaaaa—AAAAAA— *fwsh fwsh fwsh *
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,859)>* Scrackle ZAP *
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>Consegui!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>YOU DID IT! Told ya so!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Tu conseguiste, eu avisei-te!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>My battery’s totally drained today. I can’t fly another inch!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>Minha bateria está totalmente drenada hoje. Eu não posso voar mais uma polegada!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Sounds rough, yo.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Parece-me difícil.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Hey, bud. Think you could spare a little electricity to help
charge me up?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Amigo, acho que podias poupar um pouco de electricidade para ajudar.
Acusar-me?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,59)>Sorry, dude. I’m totally out of battery today too.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,59)>Desculpe, cara. Eu estou totalmente sem bateria hoje também.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Aw man! All right. Guess we’re both outta luck, huh...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>I found a spot with tons of tasty-lookin’ berries, and I
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)>reeeaaally wanted to take you there, but oh well...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah cara! Tudo bem. Acho que estamos ambos sem sorte, huh...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Eu encontrei um ponto com toneladas de bagas saboroso-lookin’, e eu
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)>Queria levar-te lá, mas...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)>Yooo! Seriously?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)>A sério?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,51)>Yeah, but I guess there’s nothin’ we can do about it now,
is there. Real shame, though...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,51)>Sim, mas acho que não há nada que possamos fazer sobre isso agora,
É uma pena, mas...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,4)>Hey, y’know what—uhhh... Hold up.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Looks like I DO have a little electricity left, yo! <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I bet it’s
enough to get us to those berries! Let’s go!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,4)>Ei, sabe que mais... espera.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Parece que ainda tenho um pouco de electricidade. <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Eu aposto que é
o suficiente para nos levar a essas bagas! Vamos!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>I was lying, ya dummy! And you fell for it!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Eu estava a mentir, seu idiota!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,56)>Whaaat?! It’s not cool to lie, yo...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,56)>Whaaat?! Não é legal mentir, yo...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,48)>Hey, you lied first! Ugh, now I’m hungry.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,48)>Ei, você mentiu primeiro! Ugh, agora eu estou com fome.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Things sure are peaceful around here, huh, Captain? Even
tiny weaklings like us don’t have much to worry about.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>As coisas estão muito calmas por aqui, não é, Capitão?
pequenos fracos como nós não têm muito com que se preocupar.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,15)>Don’t drop your guard just ’cause all’s well and good right
now, you blockhead!
<$voicel(1,5)>We use our smarts to make up for our size, got it? If you’ve
got time to relax, you’ve got time to run scenarios!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Long as we do that, we’ve got nothing to fear—not even
gettin’ attacked by some massive Pokémon!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,15)>Não baixe a guarda só porque tudo está bem e bem
Agora, seu idiota!
<$voicel(1,5)>Usamos nossas inteligências para compensar o nosso tamanho, entendeu? Se você tem
tem tempo para relaxar, você tem tempo para executar cenários!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Desde que façamos isso, não temos nada a temer – nem mesmo
ser atacado por algum Pokémon maciço!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, hey, is that <$cdef(27)>Pelipper flying this way? Check out that
gaping maw...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)> It looks hungry.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, ei, isso é... <$cdef(27)>Pelipper A voar para aqui?
Maw escancarado...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)> Parece ter fome.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)><$kfacial(1)>Gah!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)><$kfacial(1)>Gah!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>What’re you doing, Captain?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>O que está fazendo, Capitão?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>I’m playin’ dead, you blockbrain! Don’t talk to me!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)>Quick, go hide somewhere! Now!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>Estou brincando de morto, seu idiota! Não fale comigo!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)>Rápido, esconde-te em algum lugar!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,803)>There’s no <$cdef(27)>Pelipper</color>. I made it up. Sorry.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,803)>Não há nenhum <$cdef(27)>Pelipper</color>Eu inventei-o, desculpa.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>What?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,7)>You sneaky so-and-so! <$voicel(1,10)>Thought you’d play a little trick on
me, huh?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>O quê?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,7)>Seu sorrateiro! <$voicel(1,10)>Pensei que você iria jogar um pequeno truque em
Eu, huh?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>I just thought it’d be a good scenario to run...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu só pensei que seria um bom cenário para correr...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,4)>Oh, er, right. Well... Good job. Keep it up!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,4)>Muito bem, bom trabalho.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey! Don’t just chomp me out of nowhere!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$voicel(1,7)>Não me masturbe do nada!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>O-oh! Sorry! You’re just the perfect size, yo. I couldn’t
help myself...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>O-oh! Desculpe! Você é apenas o tamanho perfeito, yo. Eu não poderia
Sirva-me...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Er, perfect size? What’s that supposed to mean?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Er, tamanho perfeito? O que isso quer dizer?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,1)>Uh, y’know, like...I usually gulp up Arrokuda and use ’em
as projectiles, right? <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>But I’ve kinda been wonderin’ if
something bigger might be more effective...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,1)>Uh, você sabe, como... eu geralmente tomar Arrokuda e usar 'em
Como projéteis, certo? <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Mas eu meio que tenho me perguntado se
algo maior pode ser mais eficaz...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Wha—?! More effective?! I think I’d just get STUCK!
Wouldn’t that be a BAD thing?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>O que -?! Mais eficaz?!! Eu acho que eu só iria ficar preso!
Não seria uma coisa ruim?!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Y-yeah, I guess you’re right.
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>It’s just, like, I can’t help myself, y’know? I gotta go for
what’s challenging.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Sim, acho que tem razão.
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>É só, como, eu não posso me ajudar, você sabe? Eu tenho que ir para
o que é desafiador.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,3)>Uh... OK. Respectfully, I have no clue what you’re going
on about—but cut it out, would ya?!
<$facial(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Because next time, you’re gonna end up getting my
bzzt-bzzt-electro-shock counterattack!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,3)>Uh... OK. Respeitosamente, eu não tenho idéia do que você está indo
Mas pára com isso, está bem?
<$facial(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Porque da próxima vez, você vai acabar recebendo o meu
Bzzt-bzzt-electro-choque contra-ataque!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>A-ah...OK...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>So, like, a battle or somethin’? That seems like a kinda fun
challenge too...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Está bem...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Então, tipo, uma batalha ou algo assim? Isso parece um pouco divertido
Desafio também...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Jiggly! ♪ Puff! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Puff!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Oooh, I like this song... <wait(0.8)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Hum hum dee dum. ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Oooh, eu gosto desta canção... <wait(0.8)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Hum hum dee dum.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Puff! ♪ P...<$comeff(2,6)> Puff?
<$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Puff!<$comeff(2,6)> Puff?
<$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum hummm... ♪ I can’t stop using Metronome... ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum hummm... Não consigo parar de usar Metronome...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>H-hey!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Olá!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum dee dum... ♪ Hm hm hmmm... ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum dee dum...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Ummm... I’m not singing anymore, so...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Ummm... Eu não estou cantando mais, então...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum dee dee... ♪ Hum dee dum... ♪ Ta-daaa!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Thank you for listening to my performance!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum dee dee...
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Obrigado por ouvir a minha performance!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Whaaa? But I, um... I was singing first...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas eu... eu estava a cantar primeiro...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Feast yer eyes on these wings o’ mine! Big and
strong-lookin’, wouldn’t ya say?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Festeje seus olhos sobre estas asas do meu! Big e
olhar forte’, você não diria?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Yeah, they’re really cool! Hey, um—check out my
wings too! <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>Pretty cute, yeah? ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, eles são muito legais! Ei, um - confira meu
Asas também! <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>Muito giro, não é?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Wings? What wings? What’re you on about?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Asas? Que asas? Do que você está falando?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? Um... The wings on my back, silly!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>As asas nas minhas costas, tonto!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>I see you’ve got li’l ribbons on yer back, yeah.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Eu vejo que você tem fitas li’l em suas costas, sim.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><turn(1,180)><$voicel(1,7)>Hee hee, those aren’t ribbons—they’re wings! <wait(0.8)>Cute, right?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><turn(1,180)><$voicel(1,7)>Hee hee, essas não são fitas - elas são asas! <wait(0.8)>É giro, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, yeah, they’re cute... But they’re a bit small and
funny-shaped. <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>You can really fly with those wings?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, sim, eles são fofos... Mas eles são um pouco pequenos e
Engraçadinho. <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Consegues mesmo voar com essas asas?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Uh, yeah? I can fly no problem! Here, lemme just get
ready... OK!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Faaa! ♪ Riii! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu posso voar sem problemas!
Prontos...
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Faaa!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>What, uh...what’re you doin’?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>O que, uh ... o que você está fazendo?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I can only fly when I’m feeling really good, so first I gotta
dance so I feel, uh—more good! ♪
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Cleee faaaiii reee! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu só posso voar quando estou me sentindo muito bem, então primeiro eu tenho
Dança para que eu me sinta, uh - mais bom!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Cleee faaaiii reee!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>You sure are a strange one...
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>... ... ...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Hey, um... How long’s this dance o’ yours gonna last?
dialogues.pt_br:

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)><$cdef(27)>Clefable!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)>Wha—?!

for a second!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>The moon’s just so gorgeous, I was totally enchanted by it.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)>O quê? !
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, é você, <$cdef(27)>Wigglytuff! Eu sinto muito eu não notei você
Por um segundo!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>A lua é tão linda, que eu estava totalmente encantada com ela.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Clefable</color>. You certainly love the moon, don’t you?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>Clefable</color>Você certamente ama a lua, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes, of course! After all, the moon looks different every
single day, so I never get tired of gazing at it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>And I also feel some sort of mysterious power from it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Sim, claro! Afinal, a lua parece diferente cada
Um dia só, para nunca me cansar de olhar para ele!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>E também sinto algum tipo de poder misterioso dele!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>That’s certainly true... When I bathe in the light of the
moon, I too can feel power well up within me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Isso é certamente verdade... Quando eu me banhar na luz do
Lua, eu também posso sentir poder dentro de mim.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes, exactly! Oh, I’m so glad you understand, <$cdef(27)>Wigglytuff!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Why, whenever there’s a full moon, I get so excited I jump
up in the air!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, exatamente! Oh, Estou tão feliz que você entende, <$cdef(27)>Wigglytuff!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Por que, sempre que há uma lua cheia, eu fico tão animado que eu pulo
Para o ar!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh? <wait(0.8)><$motion(2,801)>Like this?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, sim? <wait(0.8)><$motion(2,801)>Assim?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, goodness! You can certainly jump high! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>It almost
seems as if you could float right away!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>If you kept floating higher and higher...and I grabbed
onto you...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>do you think we could reach the moon?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Meu Deus, pode saltar alto! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Quase.
Parece que pode flutuar imediatamente!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Se continuasses a flutuar cada vez mais alto... e eu agarrasse
em ti...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Achas que podemos chegar à lua?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>That...may prove difficult, I’m afraid. I’m sorry.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>Isso... pode ser difícil, receio. Sinto muito.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>*sigh* That’s what I thought. Oh, but I DO wish I could
go someday! <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>If only it weren’t so far...
dialogues.pt_br:

Vai-te embora um dia! <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Se ao menos não fosse tão longe...

<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I have to stop and listen whenever I hear you... I just can’t

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>É um som tão bonito que você faz! Eu posso ouvi-lo todo o

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)>*po-pop!*

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Y’know what, <$cdef(27)>Diglett—why don’t we have a li’l jam sesh?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Yoooooo! Sim! Esse mesmo!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Aquele som “po-pop!” tem um som muito legal para ele!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>sabe que mais? <$cdef(27)>Diglett—por que não temos um li’l jam sesh?!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Uh, sure... But...do you really think I can keep up?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Claro, mas achas mesmo que consigo acompanhar?

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>You got this!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>You just gotta time your po-poppin’ with my to-tottin’.
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>It’ll be super easy, yo!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Tu consegues!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Você só tem que cronometrar seu po-poppin 'com o meu to-to-tottin'.
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Vai ser super fácil, yo!

dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, se você diz isso... OK! Vou tentar!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Kricketot! You called that a “sesh,” right? Seshes are

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Obrigado. <$cdef(27)>Kricketot! Você chamou isso de “sesh”, certo? Seshes são
Muito divertido!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It must be nice for the three of you to always be together
like that...<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)> It gets a bit lonely being by myself all the time...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Deve ser bom para vocês os três estarem sempre juntos.
Assim...<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)> Fica um pouco solitário estar sempre sozinho...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>I dunno. That actually sounds kinda nice.
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Honestly, I’m gettin’ a little tired of these two always
taggin’ along, no matter what I do.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Não sei, parece-me bem.
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Honestamente, Estou ficando um pouco cansado desses dois sempre
a acompanhar, não importa o que eu faça.

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,2)>Hey! I was gonna say that!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,2)>Eu ia dizer isso!

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,4)>So was I!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,4)>Eu também!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>But see, that’s exactly what I mean! You all joke around
like that and it seems like so much fun!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>I wish I had brothers too... One would be courageous like
you, Dugmiddle...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>Mas veja, isso é exatamente o que eu quero dizer! Vocês todos brincam ao redor
Assim e parece muito divertido!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>Quem me dera ter irmãos também...
Tu, Dugmiddle...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Y-yeah? Like me?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Como eu?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)>And one would be smart like you, Duglefto...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,8)>Heh...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)>And maybe I’d even have a brother that was nice like
you, Dugrighto!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)>E talvez eu até mesmo teria um irmão que era agradável como
Tu, Dugrighto!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hehehe...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hehehe...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I really, really wish I had brothers like that! <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Then I could
talk to them and joke around with them like you do!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Quem me dera ter irmãos assim! <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Então eu poderia
Fale com eles e brinque com eles como você faz!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Diglett</color>, bud, come a little closer...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah! Get as close as you can!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Aproxima-te o mais que puderes!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Uh-huh! Then you won’t be lonely.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Uh-huh! Então você não estará sozinho.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Really? Oh, Dugs... Thank you! You’re all the best!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Sério? Oh, Dugs... Obrigado! Você é o melhor!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... This should be safe... M-maybe?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Isto deve ser seguro... talvez?

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>What’s up?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>O que foi?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh! Nothing! Nothing at all!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Nada mesmo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Are you sure? Well, OK...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, isn’t it a bit warm around here? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)>A little TOO warm?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>tem a certeza?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Ei, não está um pouco quente por aqui? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)>Um pouco quente demais?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh... I’m—I’m sorry...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh... Eu sinto muito...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? What’re you apologizing for?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Porque é que está a pedir desculpa?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>The heat... It’s my fault... <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>Sometimes I let my flames get
real strong without noticing, and... <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>I think it makes other
Pokémon uncomfortable...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>O calor... é minha culpa... <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>Às vezes deixo as minhas chamas ficarem
realmente forte sem perceber, e... <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>Eu acho que faz outros
Pokémon desconfortável...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, really? Well, I don’t mind it at all!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, realmente? Bem, eu não me importo nada!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,4)>But...where I used to live...<$voicel(2,5)>I accidentally set fire to all the
trees on the mountain, and...they all burned down...
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>I don’t want that to happen here... Not when
<$cdef(27)>’s
working
so hard...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,4)>Mas... onde eu costumava viver...<$voicel(2,5)>Ateei fogo acidentalmente a todos os
árvores na montanha, e... todos eles queimaram...
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Eu não quero que isso aconteça aqui... Não quando
<$cdef(27)>’s
trabalhando
Tão forte...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Wow... That must’ve been a lot. But you’re safe now! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I can
hang out with you and keep an eye on things!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>You probably wouldn’t guess it, but I actually can’t stand
the cold—so this is great for me too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Uau... Isso deve ter sido muito. Mas você está seguro agora! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu posso.
Andar com você e ficar de olho nas coisas!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Você provavelmente não iria adivinhar, mas eu realmente não posso suportar
o frio - então isso é ótimo para mim também!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>R-really? You...would? Th-thank you! That really means a
lot to me...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>A sério, tu... farias isso?
Muito para mim...
